title: Diwali Taash Night in Golf Links
place: a family bungalow in Golf Links, New Delhi
occasion: the big Diwali card party, teen patti until the small hours
blurb: Crackers outside, teen patti inside, and more money on the tables than anyone admits. By midnight one player had folded for good.

weapons.name: a golf club
weapons.found: A golf club from the study lay on the floor.

weapons.name: the vegetable cleaver
weapons.found: The vegetable cleaver from the kitchen was found under a cushion.

weapons.name: a silk tie

a scream everyone took for a rocket
